snippet.title: Airport Baggage Simulator | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Who would’ve thought sorting suitcases could be this exciting? In the brand-new Airport Baggage Simulator from publisher 3RG (3RiverGames), you step into the shoes of a freshly recruited baggage inspector. 

Airport Baggage Simulator - Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3887090/Airport_Baggage_Simulator/
